function.arguments: {"index": 4, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The `channel` was not randomly assigned — the email campaign was deliberately targeted at loyal customers. This means that `customer_segment` is confounded with `channel`. A raw difference in conversion rates between channels is biased because loyal customers have higher conversion rates regardless of the channel. To isolate the effect of the channel, I computed the difference in conversion rates within each `customer_segment`, then computed a weighted average of these differences using the distribution of segments in the email channel as weights. This adjusts for the confounding and provides an unbiased estimate of the campaign's effect."}
